
Import the SBC:
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(rlang)
library(glue)
library(here)
sbc <- readRDS(here("data", "sbc_turns_auto_utts.rds"))
```

Standardise spellings and capitalisation:
```{r}
sbc <- sbc %>%
  mutate(
    text = case_when(
      text == "uh-" ~ "uh",
      text == "hm" ~ "hmm",
      text == "m" ~ "mm",
      text == "hm-m" ~ "hm-mm",
      text == "ooh" ~ "oo",
      text == "aa" ~ "ah",
      text == "nyah" ~ "nya",
      T ~ text
    )
  )
sbc <- sbc %>%
  mutate(text_lower = case_when(kind == "word" ~ tolower(text), T ~ text))
```


Juilland's D calculations:
```{r}
#Prepare frequency table
# fmt: skip
sbc_word_perdoc_freq = sbc %>%
  group_by(docId, text_lower) %>%
  filter(kind == "word", str_detect(text_lower, "[a-z]")) %>%
  filter(!text_lower %in% c("b","c","d","e","f","g","h","j","k","l","m","n","o","p","q","qu","r","s","t","u","v","w","x","y","z","ph","th","ch","sh","bl","br","cl","cr","dr","fl","fr","gl","gr","kn","pl","pr","sc","scr","sk","sl","sm","sn","sp","spr","st","str","sw","tr","wh","wr")) %>% #skip
  count(.drop = F) %>%
  ungroup %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c("docId"), values_from = n)

sbc_word_perdoc_freq <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>%
  replace_na(
    lapply(1:60, function(x) 0) %>%
      `names<-`(colnames(sbc_word_perdoc_freq)[-1])
  )

#Julliand's U calculation
sbc_word_perdoc_freq <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>%
  mutate(
    sd = apply(as.matrix(sbc_word_perdoc_freq[, -1]), 1, function(x) sd(x)),
    vbar = apply(as.matrix(sbc_word_perdoc_freq[, -1]), 1, function(x) mean(x))
  ) %>%
  mutate(D = 1 - (sd / vbar) / sqrt(60 - 1)) %>%
  mutate(U = D * vbar * 60)

#Getting wordlists
sbc_word_perdoc_freq <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>%
  mutate(Urank = nrow(sbc_word_perdoc_freq) - rank(U) + 1)
sbc_top100 <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>% filter(Urank <= 100) %>% pull(text_lower)
sbc_top200 <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>% filter(Urank <= 200) %>% pull(text_lower)
sbc_top300 <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>% filter(Urank <= 300) %>% pull(text_lower)
sbc_top500 <- sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>% filter(Urank <= 500) %>% pull(text_lower)
write_csv(
  sbc_word_perdoc_freq %>% arrange(Urank),
  here("data", "sbc_word_perdoc_freq.csv")
)
# saveRDS(sbc_top200, here("data", "sbc_top200.rds"))
```


## IU sizes


```{r}
props <- sbc %>%
  group_by(unitId, docId) %>%
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  mutate(unitLen = sum(kind == "word", na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(text %in% sbc_top200) %>%
  group_by(text, unitLen) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(text) %>%
  mutate(word_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(prop = n / word_total)

props %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = unitLen, y = text, col = prop)) +
  geom_tile()

for (word in sbc_top200) {
  curr_df <- props %>% filter(text == word)
  ggplot(curr_df, aes(x = unitLen, y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    ggtitle(word) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 26))
  ggsave(here("output", "length_bargraphs", glue("{word}_len.png")))
}
```

```{r}
props %>%
  select(-word_total, -prop) %>%
  filter(unitLen != 0) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = n, names_sort = TRUE, names_from = "unitLen") %>%
  write_csv(here("output", "length_bargraphs", "0_words_len.csv"))
props %>%
  select(-word_total, -n) %>%
  filter(unitLen != 0) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = prop, names_sort = TRUE, names_from = "unitLen") %>%
  write_csv(here("output", "length_bargraphs", "0_words_len_prop.csv"))
```


```{r}
sbc %>%
  group_by(unitId, docId) %>%
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  summarise(unitLen = as.integer(sum(kind == "word", na.rm = T))) %>%
  filter(unitLen != 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = unitLen)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 26))
ggsave(here("output", "length_bargraphs", glue("0_OVERALL_len.png")))

iulen_nums <- sbc %>%
  group_by(unitId, docId) %>%
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  summarise(unitLen = as.integer(sum(kind == "word", na.rm = T))) %>%
  filter(unitLen != 0) %>%
  group_by(unitLen) %>%
  count()
write_csv(iulen_nums, here("output", "length_bargraphs", "0_OVERALL_len.csv"))
```

## 


```{r}
iulen_pos <- read_csv(here(
  "output",
  "length_bargraphs",
  "0_words_len_proportion_pos.csv"
))
```


```{r}
pos_ordered <- iulen_pos %>%
  group_by(PartOfSpeech) %>%
  summarise(unitiu_prop = mean(`1`)) %>%
  arrange(unitiu_prop) %>%
  pull(PartOfSpeech)

iulen_pos %>%
  mutate(
    PartOfSpeech = factor(PartOfSpeech, levels = pos_ordered),
    unit_logged = log(`1` + .0001)
  ) %>%
  filter(!(PartOfSpeech %in% "UNK" | PartOfSpeech %in% "COMPL")) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PartOfSpeech, y = unit_logged)) +
  geom_violin() +
  xlab("Majority part of speech") +
  ylab("Proportion in single-word IUs (log scale)") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-10, 0),
    breaks = seq(-10, 0, 1),
    labels = round(exp(seq(-10, 0, 1)), 4)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```


## Turn

```{r}
props_turn <- sbc %>%
  group_by(turnSeq, docId) %>%
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  mutate(turnLen = sum(kind == "word", na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(text %in% sbc_top200) %>%
  group_by(text, turnLen) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(text) %>%
  mutate(word_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(prop = n / word_total)

props_utt <- sbc %>%
  group_by(utteranceSeq, docId) %>%
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  mutate(uttLen = sum(kind == "word", na.rm = T)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(text %in% sbc_top200) %>%
  group_by(text, uttLen) %>%
  count() %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(text) %>%
  mutate(word_total = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(prop = n / word_total)
```


```{r}
for (word in sbc_top200) {
  curr_df <- props_turn %>% filter(text == word)
  ggplot(curr_df, aes(x = turnLen, y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    ggtitle(word) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 26))
  ggsave(here("output", "length_bargraphs_turn", glue("{word}_len_turn.png")))
}
for (word in sbc_top200) {
  curr_df <- props_utt %>% filter(text == word)
  ggplot(curr_df, aes(x = uttLen, y = n)) +
    geom_col() +
    ggtitle(word) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 26))
  ggsave(here("output", "length_bargraphs_utt", glue("{word}_len_utt.png")))
}
```


```{r}
props_unit_turn <- props_turn %>%
  select(prop, turnLen, text) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    values_from = "prop",
    names_sort = TRUE,
    names_from = "turnLen"
  ) %>%
  select(text, `1`) %>%
  mutate(`1` = replace_na(`1`, 0)) %>%
  rename(p_unit_turn = `1`)
props_unit_utt <- props_utt %>%
  select(prop, uttLen, text) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    values_from = "prop",
    names_sort = TRUE,
    names_from = "uttLen"
  ) %>%
  select(text, `1`) %>%
  mutate(`1` = replace_na(`1`, 0)) %>%
  rename(p_unit_utt = `1`)
```




```{r}
iulen_pos %>%
  left_join(props_unit_turn, by = c("TEXT" = "text")) %>%
  left_join(props_unit_utt, by = c("TEXT" = "text")) %>%
  filter(!(PartOfSpeech %in% "UNK")) %>%
  mutate(
    PartOfSpeech = factor(PartOfSpeech, levels = pos_ordered),
    unit_logged = log(p_unit_turn + .0001)
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PartOfSpeech, y = unit_logged)) +
  geom_violin(bw = .5) +
  xlab("Majority part of speech") +
  ylab("Proportion in single-word turns (log scale)") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-10, 0),
    breaks = seq(-10, 0, 1),
    labels = round(exp(seq(-10, 0, 1)), 4)
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 20, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14)
  ) +
  coord_flip()
```


```{r}
iulen_pos %>%
  left_join(props_unit_turn, by = c("TEXT" = "text")) %>%
```

```{r}
sbc %>%
  group_by(unitId, docId) %>%
  left_join(
    iulen_pos %>% select(TEXT, PartOfSpeech),
    by = c("text" = "TEXT")
  ) %>%
  mutate(text = tolower(text)) %>%
  mutate(isInteract = (PartOfSpeech == "INTERACTIVE")) %>%
  summarise(
    unitLen = as.integer(sum(kind == "word", na.rm = T)),
    PartOfSpeech = PartOfSpeech[1]
  ) %>%
  filter(unitLen != 0, !is.na(PartOfSpeech)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = unitLen, col = isInteract)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 26))
```
